restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเดนท์แอนด์สไมล์
text: This is a really great clinic! The dentist is kind and does a great job. All the assistants are lovely and give excellent advice. I really like it here. I came for the first time without expecting so much, but now I'm a regular customer. You have to book an appointment in advance though, because the dentist is amazing and it's always so crowded! Love it! 💕
author_name: ภัทริกา เดชาฤทธิ์

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเดนท์แอนด์สไมล์
text: I've used their services about 3 times, if I remember correctly. The male doctor who owns the clinic is lovely, skilled, and has a good personality. However, the overweight woman who takes appointments, books reservations, sits at the front, and answers my phone calls is absolutely terrible. (That day, I had an accident and broke my tooth. I drove to the clinic to ask for advice and initial consultation for about 5 minutes, and to schedule an emergency appointment as a returning customer with a history there. I wasn't allowed to see the doctor because I hadn't made an appointment in advance. I went home and called back to schedule an appointment. They said I had a standby slot for Monday or could book for Thursday. It's now Thursday noon, and I still haven't called back.) ... I'm done with this clinic and will go elsewhere. I apologize to the doctor for writing this kind of review.

text: I went to get a filling for a tooth that had worn down from brushing. The dentist wouldn't fill it because I was brushing incorrectly. He recommended brushing properly before coming for treatment. It's currently decayed and I'm about to get a root canal. I understand the dentist's work, but I'm angry at him. If I have children, I'll make them better dentists. Thank you.
